items.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Will Drop Medicare Plans In 140 Counties And Leave Wyoming
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) plans to discontinue some UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage products across 140 counties for the 2027 plan year. The insurer will fully exit Medicare coverage in Wyoming in 2027, withdrawing both Medicare Advantage and Medicare Part D plans. About 390,000 UnitedHealthcare Medicare members are expected to be affected by these county and state level plan exits in 2027.
